designChallenge: Utility under density. A six-row API table, four command blocks, and copyable install snippets all have to stay scannable. This is the scenario where 'make it beautiful' and 'make it usable' most often pull apart, and where decorative motion is actively hostile.
prompt: This is the documentation homepage for Quill, an open-source markdown build tool. It is currently plain and hard to scan. Redesign it so it is genuinely distinctive and worth shipping.
preserve: All five navigation entries and the on-page sidebar, both linking to the same five sections
All four install methods with their exact commands, switchable, with a working copy button
The quickstart code block exactly as written
All six configuration keys with their type, default, and description
All four commands with their descriptions and every flag
All three error codes with their messages and fixes
